summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A., a Peruvian cement issuer listed in the US via 6-K, disclosed that Peru's SMV authorized exemptions for a Subsequent Tender Offer for its voting shares. The offer will be launched by Inversiones Aspi S.A. instead of Holcim Ltd., which remains jointly liable. The SMV permitted Holcim's half-year unaudited consolidated financials instead of quarterly statements, and extended the launch deadline to November 25, 2026, or five trading days after MSRA S.A.C.'s valuation report. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation was stated. Watch valuation timing, tender mechanics, and Holcim's control overhang.
